title: Strategy Parser Canonical Schema
description: Validation schema for deterministic parsing of natural language trading strategies into canonical JSON.

signals.description: All technical indicators, signals, and external reference calculations required by the strategy.

indicators.description: List of technical indicators referenced in the conditions (e.g., RSI, SMA, EMA, MACD).

id.description: Unique string ID used to reference this indicator in conditions (e.g., 'indicator_1').

name.description: The canonical name of the indicator (e.g., 'SMA', 'RSI', 'EMA', 'MACD', 'KNOXVILLE_DIVERGENCE').

input_node.description: Optional arithmetic tree to use as custom input data instead of default price data.

operation.description: The core trading rules, structured as list of entry and exit condition trees.

entry.description: Array of logical condition trees. If evaluated to true, an entry (buy/sell) signal is generated.

exit.description: Array of logical condition trees. If evaluated to true, an exit (close position) signal is generated.

risk.description: Risk management rules including stop losses, profit targets, trailing stops, and risk-reward constraints.

stop_loss.description: Defines the stop loss rule (e.g., type: 'percentage', 'value', 'atr', 'indicator', or 'price_level').

value.description: The value associated with the stop loss type (e.g., 1.5 for a 1.5% stop loss).

reference.description: The reference point from which stop loss is calculated (e.g., 'entry_price', 'high', 'low').

direction.description: The trade direction constraint for the stop loss (e.g., 'long', 'short').

atr_multiple.description: The multiplier applied to the ATR (Average True Range) value if type is 'atr'.

price_level.description: A specific static price level at which to place the stop loss.

indicator_ref.description: A reference ID pointing to a technical indicator defining the stop level (e.g., 'indicator_1').

take_profit.description: Defines the take profit target rule (e.g., type: 'percentage', 'risk_reward_ratio', or 'indicator').

value.description: The value associated with the target type (e.g., 3.0 for a 3% target).

target_indicator.description: A reference ID pointing to a technical indicator defining the target level (e.g., 'indicator_1').

price_level.description: A specific static price level at which to place the profit target.

risk_reward_ratio.description: The multiplier of the stop loss size to set the target (e.g., 2.0 for a 2:1 risk/reward target).

trailing_stop.description: Defines trailing stop rules, allowing stops to move dynamically as price advances.

value.description: The value defining the trail size (e.g., 2.0 for a 2% trail).

trail_amount.description: The distance or value by which the stop loss trails the price.

reference.description: The reference point from which the trailing starts (e.g., 'entry_price', 'highest_high').

indicator_ref.description: A reference ID pointing to a technical indicator defining the trailing stop level.

risk_reward.description: Rules or constraints concerning the acceptable risk-to-reward ratio of a trade.

ratio.description: The risk-to-reward ratio constraint value (e.g., 2.0 for a minimum 1:2 risk-reward).

value.description: A literal value associated with risk/reward configuration.
The value associated with the position sizing type.

node.description: A node in a logical conditions tree. It can be a logical operator grouping other nodes, or a direct comparison/crossover between two operands.

id.description: A unique identifier for this condition node (e.g., 'condition_1').

type.description: The logic or comparison operator: 'AND'/'OR' for grouping child nodes; 'GREATER_THAN', 'LESS_THAN', etc. for comparing operand_1 and operand_2; 'CROSS_ABOVE' or 'CROSS_BELOW' for crossover checks.

children.description: Array of child nodes when type is logical (e.g., child conditions that must all be true for an 'AND' node).

operand_1.description: The first/left operand in a comparison or crossover check (e.g., the indicator value).

operand_2.description: The second/right operand in a comparison or crossover check (e.g., a constant value or another indicator).

lookback_periods.description: Number of historical bars/periods to check when evaluating this condition.

direction.description: The direction to evaluate the sequence. BACKWARD or FORWARD.

count.description: The number of consecutive occurrences required for the sequence.

condition.description: The logical condition to evaluate over the sequence.

setup_condition.description: The condition that arms the state machine for FOLLOWED_BY nodes.

trigger_condition.description: The condition that fires the state machine after being armed for FOLLOWED_BY nodes.

max_bars_between.description: The maximum number of bars allowed between setup and trigger for FOLLOWED_BY nodes.

operand.description: An individual term used inside a condition check. It can refer to an indicator, raw market data, a fixed constant, or a chart pattern.

type.description: The source type of the operand.

operator.description: The arithmetic operator (only valid if type is 'arithmetic').

operation.description: Alias for operator (only valid if type is 'arithmetic').

operand_1.description: The first operand for the arithmetic operation.

operand_2.description: The second operand for the arithmetic operation.

indicator_id.description: The ID of the technical indicator referenced from the signals.indicators array (only valid if type is 'indicator').

property.description: The specific field/line of the indicator to check (e.g., 'value' for RSI; 'macd', 'signal', or 'histogram' for MACD).

data_type.description: The price or volume element to reference (only valid if type is 'market_data', e.g., 'CLOSE', 'OPEN', 'HIGH', 'LOW', 'VOLUME').

lookback.description: The index of the historical candle to look back (0 for the current candle, 1 for the previous candle, etc.).

value.description: The literal numeric, string, or boolean value (only valid if type is 'constant').

pattern_type.description: The type of candlestick or structural chart pattern (only valid if type is 'pattern', e.g., 'DOJI', 'DOUBLE_BOTTOM').

parameters.description: Detection settings or arguments for finding the pattern.

lookback_periods.description: Number of bars to look back when scanning for the specified pattern.
